product.subject: Wholesale All White Breathable Knit Lace-Up Walking Shoes Lightweight EVA Sole Mesh Solid Spring Summer Autumn BQ006 M8811

product_faq.question: Which color and EU size combinations are listed?
product_faq.answer: White Pink: EU 35–40; White Purple: EU 35–40; White Green: EU 35–45; All White: EU 35–45; All Black: EU 35–45; White Grey: EU 35–45; Black White: EU 35–45.

product_faq.question: Which variants have fleece lining?
product_faq.answer: The documented fleece options are Black White and All Black. Other colorways are regular versions; White Purple and White Pink are limited to EU 35–40 in the source assortment.

product_faq.question: What should I check during a sample fitting?
product_faq.answer: Try the sample with the intended socks. Adjust the laces, then check toe room, instep fit and heel hold before deciding the bulk EU size mix.

product_faq.question: What is the minimum order for the original style?
product_faq.answer: The listed original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; branding and custom packaging are quoted separately.

product_faq.question: How can I request a sample?
product_faq.answer: Send the selected color or lining variant, EU size and delivery postcode for a sample quotation. It sets out the sample charge, courier cost and proposed dispatch date.

product_faq.question: What should I send for a branding or packaging proposal?
product_faq.answer: Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the proposal for this style and set out the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.

product_faq.question: How can I get a delivered quotation?
product_faq.answer: Send pair quantities by color and EU size, the destination postcode or port and your packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and includes the proposed dispatch and transit schedule.

struct_detail.product_summary: Knit lace-up casual shoes with a chunky EVA sole and a raised contrast toe area. The thicker sole profile gives the style a bold everyday look. Regular and selected fleece-lined variants allow buyers to distinguish the lining choice when building an assortment.
struct_detail.company_summary: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is a footwear factory located in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. We supply casual walking shoes and related footwear for overseas B2B buyers. Product materials, colors, size ratios, packing and customization requirements are confirmed according to the current style and order details.
